title: Epstein's listening post at One Brattle Square

tellings.quote: He had another listening post called One Brattle Square.

plain: The financier Jeffrey Epstein had another "listening post", as the mathematician Eric Weinstein calls it, at One Brattle Square in Cambridge, Massachusetts, in the 2000s. Weinstein cites the released Epstein files for this and mentions the scientist Martin Nowak alongside it. The point, as he tells it, is that Epstein kept close watch on scientists in the Cambridge academic world.
